newsitem.title: USA: Nash Finch expects to buy Super Foods soon.
newsitem.headline: Nash Finch expects to buy Super Foods soon.

text.p: Nash Finch Co said Wednesday it expects to complete the previously announced acquisition of Super Food Services Inc soon, noting that the Hart-Scott-Rodino waiting period has expired.

"With this acquisition, Nash Finch will become the third largest public grocery wholesaler and will be positioned as a stronger player in the consolidating grocery industry," said president Al Flaten.
Earlier, Nash Finch posted third-quarter earnings per share rose to $0.61 from $0.46 while sales advanced to $1.0 billion from $918.8 million.

"Sales gains for the quarter came primarily from our wholesale operations, while all three of our business segments -- wholesale, retail and produce marketing -- contributed to the strong earnings improvement," Flaten noted.

"Wholesale results benefited from our 1996 acquisitions of the Military Distributors of Virginia operation at the beginning of January, and T.J. Morris Co at the end of July," he added. "And it should be noted that 1995 results included the convenience store wholesale distribution businesses that we sold in December 1995."
